description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join an early-stage AI company building multimodal agents for customer communication across voice, text, and email. You will own a core product or infrastructure domain end to end, working closely with customers and the engineering team to shape and ship production systems.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own a product or technical domain from architecture through frequent production releases.

 - Speak with customers, synthesize feedback, and make product decisions without a dedicated product manager.

 - Build and improve multimodal agents, including low-latency voice experiences and persistent conversations across channels.

 - Set quality practices for non-deterministic systems, including evaluations, prompt versioning, guardrails, and drift detection.

 - Work across React and Next.js frontends, Node.js backends, and Python services.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Three to eight years of full-stack engineering experience, with evidence of shipping and scaling products in fast-paced environments.

 - Production proficiency in TypeScript, Node.js, React, and Next.js, plus experience building with LLM APIs or agent SDKs.

 - End-to-end ownership of production systems and product decisions, including customer discovery and feedback synthesis.

 - Depth in at least one area: stateful agents and memory, agent evaluations and guardrails, B2B2C or marketplace architecture, or production voice and messaging agents.

 - Python experience with real-time voice systems or evaluation tooling, and familiarity with infrastructure such as Redis, job queues, and deployment and monitoring tools.

 - Strong AI or agentic systems experience, sound computer science fundamentals, and the ability to work independently in an early-stage environment.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary: $180,000 to $250,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is not available.


LOCATION

On-site, five days per week in New York, New York.
